contexts.text: This was the brazen wall. Described. SE 228.
She marcheth upon the wall () = to fight against falsity. Explained.
A wall = the truths of faith, which defend; and, in the opposite sense, the falsities which are destroyed. Illustrated.
The wall (of the holy Jerusalem) = the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord, and derivatively, the truth of faith from the good of charity. Explained.
( = the truths of faith which defend the new Church. AC 8988:4.) 9603[2]. AC 9643:4. AC 9863:2. NJHD 1:2. ( = the truth which protects from the assault of falsities and evils. HH 73:2. HH 307:2.)
The waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left () = that they were withheld on all sides from falsities. Explained. AC 8235.
The walls of Jericho () = the falsities which defended evils.
They run on the wall () = (on) essential falsity.
The wall and its foundations () = doctrine from the literal sense of the Word.
The Word in the ultimate or natural sense, which is the sense of its letter, is signified by the wall of the Holy Jerusalem, the building of which was of jasper... DSS 43.
A city seen there with a wall round it.

Had a wall great and high () = the Word in the sense of the letter from which is the doctrine of the New Church. As the holy city Jerusalem = the Lord's New Church as to doctrine, its wall = the Word in the sense of the letter from which is the doctrine; for this sense protects the spiritual sense... as a wall protects a city and its inhabitants. TCR 217.
A wall = that which protects, and, where the Church is treated of, the Word in the sense of the letter. Illustrated. AR 904. AR 909. AR 911.
The wall of the city had twelve foundations () = that the Word in the sense of the letter contains all things of the doctrine of the New Church.
If anyone strikes his hand against a wall... is it the wall that occasions the hurt...
City, and wall = the things of doctrine.
Against all the walls round about () = to destroy all the protecting truths.
Walls of brass () = good protecting.
Walls and bulwarks () = truths which protect.
The wall of the holy Jerusalem is said to be of jasper, because a wall = Divine truth protecting. AE 629:7.
The walls that shall be shaken... () = protecting truths, which are, in general, that there is a God, that the Word is Divine, and that there is an eternal life.
The walls of her palaces () = all protecting truths. Palaces = the things of doctrine.
Wall = defence.
Tower, and wall () = falsities of doctrine confirmed.
A wall = truths defending against falsities and evils.
The wall () = the truth of doctrine protecting; here, falsified, because without good.
A wall of fire () = protection by the Divine love; for this the Hells cannot approach.
Lofty tower, and fortified wall () = confirmed principles of falsity.
The overthrow of the wall of Jericho = a laying bare to all evil and falsity.
The walls which they shall destroy () = doctrinal things.
